3D Correlation Space

Goal:

  1. Want to construct an approach that allow us to claim “we are 95% confident that this confidence region covers the true set”.

Constructing the full space

Approaches:

  1. Construct x, y, z \(\in\) [-1,1]. Check which combination is positive semi-definite using determinants. Plot results

  2. Leverage LKJ distribution, sample N samples and plot.
